scope: Real Chromium component, layout/input, IndexedDB and Web Audio verification. The calculator component fixtures use synthetic frames and mocked Worker acknowledgements; they do not execute a ROM or establish stock-firmware compatibility.

checks: Lazy keypad/model/view races retain the latest model and dispose old subscriptions.
Physical keyboard input, key legends and active indicators agree with the skin manifest.
Synthetic full canvas RGBA, changed/blank frames and PNG download are exact.
English/Chinese settings apply and cancel preserve draft semantics.
Settings Transfer tab can configure transfer Unlimited during active work; Connections has no duplicate switch.
File chooser accepts arbitrary suffixes and preserves exact bytes.
Upload batches retain completed files and queued files after failure, support retry/skip, and clear stale error identities.
Specific Wire cancellation and unknown technical errors have localized main text with collapsed original diagnostics.
HP39g+ Wire and HP39gs USB/Ser hints use their own stock menu names.
HP39 catalog/ZIP receive and download preserve object bytes and directory aliases.
Unmounting removes frame subscriptions and leaves no uncaught page errors.
Unchanged source artwork is clipped at the measured line below FN; transforms and hit areas agree.
Pointer clicks on all six FN keys and a regular key emit one expected scan each.
Enter activation works on both panels.
One LCD and the same key nodes persist across all three appearances; synthetic pixels remain exact.
The workspace fits at normal zoom and remains scrollable at large zoom.
Audio preferences apply, gesture listeners unlock once per event, and unmount removes them.

indexeddb.scope: Actual browser IndexedDB and reload, not an in-memory database mock. The bytes are generated, not a calculator checkpoint.

checks: all SD chooser inputs accept arbitrary suffixes
editable short names validate without truncation; arbitrary and empty file bytes round-trip
duplicate in later batch member keeps complete draft byte-exact
new directory and nested file survive navigation and full-image download
renames preserve payload/directory contents; collision rolls back exact image
delete confirmation/cancel works; nonempty folders rejected; files and empty folders deleted
malformed image and file-read failure visibly preserve current draft
download failure is visible; reopening an arbitrary-suffix image preserves nested contents
390px viewport and both language controls render without horizontal overflow
failed File read and Worker rejection retain exact draft and support retry
production insertion sends exact image/read-only state; mounted card has no host file editor
closing during pending file read cannot mutate a new draft; no uncaught page errors
sd_files.scope: Actual File chooser, downloads, React/controller and complete generated card-byte comparisons; Worker insertion is explicitly acknowledged by the fixture. Original-ROM SD tests remain separate.

checks: No AudioContext exists before a user gesture.
The real AudioContext reaches running and receives nonzero PCM.
Pause/reset cancels every queued source; dispose completes.
audio.scope: Replay of already-observed firmware edges into the real browser audio path. This is not a new ROM execution, a physical speaker measurement or a device-wide browser compatibility claim.

reviewed.observation: HP39g+ desktop: six complete FN keys sit below the LCD in the left panel; all other keys are in the right panel.
HP49g+ landscape phone: both panels remain visible with FN keys on the screen side and no horizontal page overflow.
The Chinese Transfer tab contains its own checked transfer Unlimited switch, explanatory text and Apply/Cancel controls.
The specific calculator-cancelled Wire warning is rendered in Chinese; Technical details is collapsed and recovery instructions remain visible.
The unknown-error fallback is rendered in Chinese in both summary and failed batch row; the previous error identity does not remain.
The Chinese 390px SD draft shows Download/Rename/Delete controls, directory navigation and name input without horizontal overflow.

cjk_environment.reason: This minimal Linux image has no system CJK font; the initial browser assertions passed but screenshots showed missing glyphs.
cjk_environment.resolution: Load the official pinned Noto font into only the test page; no product files, system fonts, global browser trust or settings are modified.

font.scope: Task-local browser verification only; not bundled or installed

private_copy_changes: Resolve the repository root from the private harness location.
Inject the task-local font for text and native form controls.
Capture settings and both warning states after their existing assertions and a 250ms visual settle.

publication_excludes: Recorded audio and stock LCD pixel data
Test-only font, screenshots and private logs
remaining_gates_owned_by_root: Production HTTP Worker and stop/trace recovery
Original-ROM production browser and SD workflows
Final build, GitHub CI and deployed-site verification
